api-foundations.copy: Date Range Picker API exposes label, from/to values, presets, density, state, invalid, disabled, and local change events while Flow owns range geometry, focus, depth, and accessibility.

props.name: from
props.notes: Start date shortcut when not passing value.

props.name: to
props.notes: End date shortcut when not passing value.

props.name: placeholder
props.notes: Fallback copy when no range is selected.

props.name: density
props.notes: Maps field and day target rhythm to Density.

props.name: presets
props.notes: Shows local quick presets; false keeps the bounded calendar field without shortcut buttons.

props.name: invalid
props.notes: Forces invalid visual state when validation is owned externally.

props.name: onOpenChange
props.notes: Called when the local calendar panel opens or closes.

groups.title: Use
items: Use for one bounded start/end date range.
Keep the selected range visible as text.
Use presets only as local shortcuts.
Compose beside Combobox or Select for ZIP-style combo-range headers.

groups.title: Avoid
items: Do not make it own dashboard refresh.
Do not document combo-range as a second Date Range Picker component.
Do not add comparison windows as variants.
Do not hide start/end meaning in color only.

groups.title: Review
items: Check range edge and middle states.
Check preset labels and date math.

miel.copy: MIEL treats Date Range Picker as one bounded range field. Agents may place it when the product needs start/end dates, but humans confirm reporting sync, comparison rules, and data refresh pattern behavior.
canDecide: Use Date Range Picker for reporting windows and export ranges.
Use local presets for rolling windows.
Keep range selection separate from dashboard refresh.
mustAsk: The range triggers data loading, URL changes, or saved views.
Comparison windows or fiscal calendars are required.
Disabled date rules or locale are unclear.
rejectIf: Date Range Picker becomes a dashboard filter pattern.
The selected range is not text-backed.
miel.handoff: I am using Date Range Picker for one bounded start/end range. Please confirm locale, preset list, disabled range rules, and the pattern that owns data refresh.
